name: Linklet Seller Report
summary: A weekly seller performance email that reads Linklet's PostgreSQL data and sends each seller a view, save, and active-listing summary through Resend.
problem: Sellers on a marketplace need to know whether their listings are getting attention. Without a weekly nudge, a listing that needs a better photo or a price change just sits there.
solution: A Node.js job queries seller and listing activity, builds a compact HTML email with total views, saves, active listings, a per-listing table, and one practical tip, then delivers it through Resend. The job is designed to use a read-only database user and keeps credentials in environment variables.
